regime.label: Dealer short-gamma across the whole 960-1150 grid while protection OI builds into a 90-day quarter
evidence: -188 baht/pt total net GEX today versus +374 yesterday and +479 on 09-23: the sign flipped and cumulative net GEX never crosses zero inside 960-1150, so there is no gamma flip left in the listed grid (1140 yesterday).

-201 baht/pt net GEX inside the +/-1 sigma band (1062-1076) with spot 1069.1 sitting at the cumulative trough near 1070 - dealers amplify rather than dampen moves at the money; the band only turns positive (+16 baht/pt across 1048-1090) once the 1080/1090 call OI is included.

+301 puts and +274 calls added today on 1,915 contracts of volume (3.2x yesterday's 598) while ATM IV fell 1.62 pts to 10.57% - volume, OI build and an IV move all confirm the flow is live, and the IV direction says it was vol supply, not panic hedging.

331-371 put OI at 1020/1040/1060/1070 is a flat plateau, not a wall, and the 682-lot 960 put wall sits 109 pts (10.2%) below spot - no near-money magnet, the classic Protection signature for a 90-DTE back quarter.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1069.1 closed -8.7 pts (-0.81%) and landed 0.9 pts under the 1070 max-pain anchor, the tightest spot-to-max-pain gap of the series so far. 1,915 contracts traded, 3.2x yesterday's 598, and total OI rose 575 to 8,432 - yet ATM IV fell 1.62 pts to 10.57%, the lowest print in the 11-session record, which marks the day as vol supply rather than protection panic. Net dealer gamma flipped to -188 baht/pt from +374, and with cumulative net GEX negative across every listed strike the gamma flip has moved above the 1150 top strike. The 631-lot 1100 call wall is 31 pts away, 4.4x the 7.1-pt 1 sigma daily move, so no wall is within reach of a single session.
what_changed: Net GEX flipped sign: +374 baht/pt yesterday to -188 today, and the gamma flip left the grid entirely (1140 yesterday, none inside 960-1150 now).
ATM IV collapsed 1.62 pts to 10.57% - the lowest of 11 sessions - shrinking the 1 sigma daily move from 8.28 to 7.12 pts even as spot fell 8.7.
Volume exploded 3.2x to 1,915 contracts, concentrated in calls at 1060 (206), 1090 (162) and 1080 (149) - 47% of the 1,092 call lots - against 823 put lots.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Since 09-23 spot has drained 13.3 pts (1082.4 to 1069.1, -1.23%) while total OI grew 30.2% from 6,476 to 8,432 - price falling into a rising burden map is accumulation of protection, not distribution of it. Over the same five sessions ATM IV compressed 1.83 pts (12.40% to 10.57%) and the 1 sigma move shrank from 8.46 to 7.12 pts, so the structure is being built at progressively cheaper vol. Max pain drifted down one grid step to 1070 on 09-29 and spot has now converged on it to within 0.9 pts, while the 1100 call wall has held its position for all 11 sessions and thickened from 590 to 631 lots. The decisive change is the gamma sign: net GEX ran +489, +479, +450, +171, +360, +374 from 09-22 through 09-29 and printed -188 today, with the flip strike walking 1130 to 1140 to off-grid - dealers have gone from dampening moves to amplifying them. The one other negative-GEX session in the 11-day record, 09-17 at -96 baht/pt, coincided with the largest single-day drop of the sample, -11.9 pts.

strategies.name: 1050/1020 put debit spread
strategies.rationale: -201 baht/pt net GEX at the money means a move down forces dealers to sell into it, and at 10.57% ATM IV the 30-pt wing is being bought at the cheapest vol of the series.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 6.95 pts = net debit (16.95 mid paid, 10.00 mid received); max gain 23.05 pts at 1020 or below; breakeven 1043.05.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1080, where per-strike net GEX turns positive (+168 baht/pt) and the short-gamma-below premise fails.

strategies.name: 1080/1100 call debit spread
strategies.rationale: The 631-lot 1100 call wall caps the realistic upside, so the short leg is sold exactly where the burden map is heaviest while the long leg is bought at 10.57% ATM IV.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 6.85 pts = net debit (18.05 mid paid, 11.20 mid received); max gain 13.15 pts at 1100 or above; breakeven 1086.85.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1050, which puts spot 50 pts (7 sigma of daily move) under the short strike and makes the debit dead money.

strategies.name: Long iron condor 1020/1050 x 1080/1100
strategies.rationale: Short dealer gamma at the money plus the cheapest IV of 11 sessions and an 80-pt 25D band (1020-1100) argues for paying for range expansion in either direction rather than selling it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 13.80 pts = total net debit, realised if spot expires anywhere between 1050 and 1080; max gain 16.20 pts down at 1020, 6.20 pts up at 1100.
strategies.invalidation: Net GEX turning positive again around 1070 (yesterday it was +374 baht/pt overall) restores dealer dampening and kills the range-expansion premise.

S50Z26.prediction: 1069.1 sits 0.9 pts from the 1070 max-pain anchor inside a 1020-1100 25D band, so the base case is a 7.1-pt-per-day random walk that stays inside 1020-1100 (a 10D band of 990-1130), but the -188 baht/pt gamma posture means any break is amplified rather than absorbed. The asymmetry is downward: there is no near-money put wall between 1070 and the structural 960 wall, so a slide through 1020 has 60 pts of empty burden map beneath it. A close above 1080 flips per-strike net GEX positive and invalidates that bias.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no execution is suggested. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and pinning to 1070 is a tendency rather than a mechanical outcome - materially weaker than for physically-settled single stocks. At 90 DTE gamma effects are diffuse and the 1100 call wall sits 4.4x the 7.1-pt 1 sigma move away, so no wall should be treated as a hard level. Defined risk is not low risk: each debit above is 100% at risk if the range holds, and the 25D skew of -1.37 is partly an artifact of wide OTM-call quotes (the 1030 call prints 16.9% IV while 39 pts in the money), so treat the call-rich headline with less weight than the put-tail bid.
